Command reference
=================

This snapshot is generated from the current CLI parser. It includes all
26 public subcommands, their flags, choices and parser defaults. It does
not import command implementations or execute an analysis. Defaults of
``None`` mean unspecified; some commands require an explicit output at
runtime. See the user-guide pages for biological semantics and known
implementation limits; parser acceptance is not a guarantee of behavior.

Regenerate after changing the CLI using :doc:`documentation`.

.. _cli-create:

GenoKit create
--------------

.. code-block:: text

   usage: GenoKit create [-h] -a ANNOTATION -g GENOME -o OUTPUT_DIR -p PREFIX
                         -s {gff,gtf} [--database-format {sqlite,pickle}]
                         [--skip-fasta-index]
   
   options:
     -h, --help            show this help message and exit
     -a, --annotation ANNOTATION
                           genome annotation path (gff or gtf), uncompressed or gzip (.gz)
     -g, --genome GENOME   genome fasta path, uncompressed or bgzip (.gz) ONLY (for efficient indexing)
     -o, --output_dir OUTPUT_DIR
                           database output directory path
     -p, --prefix PREFIX   database prefix
     -s, --style {gff,gtf}
                           annotation syntax; use gff for GFF3 and gtf for GTF
     --database-format {sqlite,pickle}
                           database backend (default: sqlite; pickle writes a .pkl file)
     --skip-fasta-index    do not create a missing FASTA .fai index

**Parser defaults and requirements**

* ``-a, --annotation``: required.
* ``-g, --genome``: required.
* ``-o, --output_dir``: required.
* ``-p, --prefix``: required.
* ``-s, --style``: required; choices: gff, gtf.
* ``--database-format``: default: 'sqlite'; choices: sqlite, pickle.
* ``--skip-fasta-index``: default: False.

.. _cli-kmer:

GenoKit kmer
------------

.. code-block:: text

   usage: GenoKit kmer [-h] [-f FASTA] [-d DATABASE] [-g GENOME]
                       [--source-type {genome,transcriptome}] [-j JELLYFISH]
                       [--engine {auto,jellyfish,python}] [-t THREADS]
                       [--hash-size HASH_SIZE] [-l LENGTH] [--lengths LENGTHS]
                       -o OUTPUT_DIR [--sqlite-db SQLITE_DB]
                       [--register-jf REGISTER_JF] [-r]
   
   Build a source-aware k-mer catalogue for GenoKit design commands.
   
   Important k values:
     k=18-25    Complete primer sequences; exact primer lengths are queried.
     k=19-21    Complete sgRNA, siRNA and shRNA target sequences.
   
   Recommended: build k=18-25 for both biological sources. The genome
   dataset supports genomic primers and sgRNA; the mature-transcriptome dataset
   supports RT-PCR/qPCR primers, siRNA and shRNA. Both sources can coexist in
   the same genokit.kmer.sqlite catalogue and are selected independently.
   
   options:
     -h, --help            show this help message and exit
     -f, --fasta FASTA     genome FASTA, or a pre-built mature-transcript FASTA
     -d, --database DATABASE
                           annotation database used to build a mature transcriptome
     -g, --genome GENOME   genome FASTA used with --database for transcriptome counting
     --source-type {genome,transcriptome}
                           biological source recorded in the k-mer catalogue (default: genome)
     -j, --jellyfish JELLYFISH
                           path to the jellyfish executable
     --engine {auto,jellyfish,python}
                           counting engine (default: auto)
     -t, --threads THREADS
                           worker threads for Jellyfish (default: all available CPUs)
     --hash-size HASH_SIZE
                           Jellyfish hash size (default: 3G)
     -l, --length LENGTH   single k-mer length (default: 18); use --lengths for a design catalogue
     --lengths LENGTHS     multiple k values (recommended: 18-25 for complete primers and RNA targets)
     -o, --output_dir OUTPUT_DIR
                           kmer output directory (auto-created)
     --sqlite-db SQLITE_DB
                           SQLite k-mer catalogue (default: OUTPUT_DIR/genokit.kmer.sqlite)
     --register-jf REGISTER_JF
                           register an existing Jellyfish database; may be repeated
     -r, --reverse_complement
                           include reverse-complement k-mers (canonical mode with Jellyfish)

**Parser defaults and requirements**

* ``-f, --fasta``: default: unspecified.
* ``-d, --database``: default: unspecified.
* ``-g, --genome``: default: unspecified.
* ``--source-type``: default: 'genome'; choices: genome, transcriptome.
* ``-j, --jellyfish``: default: unspecified.
* ``--engine``: default: 'auto'; choices: auto, jellyfish, python.
* ``-t, --threads``: default: unspecified.
* ``--hash-size``: default: '3G'.
* ``-l, --length``: default: 18.
* ``--lengths``: default: unspecified.
* ``-o, --output_dir``: required.
* ``--sqlite-db``: default: unspecified.
* ``--register-jf``: default: unspecified.
* ``-r, --reverse_complement``: default: False.

.. _cli-sirna:

GenoKit sirna
-------------

.. code-block:: text

   usage: GenoKit sirna [-h] -d DATABASE [-f {csv,fasta}] -g GENOME [-i GENE]
                        [-k KMER_BIN] [--jellyfish JELLYFISH] [-l {19,20,21}]
                        [--region {cds,transcript}] [--target-mode {all,any}]
                        [--top TOP] [-o OUTPUT] [-s {gff,gtf}] [-v]
   
   options:
     -h, --help            show this help message and exit
     -d, --database DATABASE
                           SQLite (.sqlite) or pickle (.pkl) database generated by create
     -f, --output_format {csv,fasta}
                           output format (default: csv)
     -g, --genome GENOME   genome fasta file
     -i, --gene GENE       specific gene id (extract all if omitted)
     -k, --kmer_bin KMER_BIN
                           source-aware GenoKit k-mer SQLite database
     --jellyfish JELLYFISH
                           optional Jellyfish executable for .jf queries; specify if the saved path is invalid or Jellyfish is not on PATH
     -l, --length {19,20,21}
                           siRNA length (default: 21)
     --region {cds,transcript}
                           target region: CDS (default, compatible) or mature transcript
     --target-mode {all,any}
                           target all input transcripts of each gene (default) or at least one transcript
     --top TOP             maximum number of ranked siRNAs to keep per gene
     -o, --output OUTPUT   output file path
     -s, --style {gff,gtf}
                           gtf database or gff database
     -v, --print           output to stdout. -v and -o option are mutually exclusive

**Parser defaults and requirements**

* ``-d, --database``: required.
* ``-f, --output_format``: default: 'csv'; choices: csv, fasta.
* ``-g, --genome``: required.
* ``-i, --gene``: default: unspecified.
* ``-k, --kmer_bin``: default: unspecified.
* ``--jellyfish``: default: unspecified.
* ``-l, --length``: default: 21; choices: 19, 20, 21.
* ``--region``: default: 'cds'; choices: cds, transcript.
* ``--target-mode``: default: 'all'; choices: all, any.
* ``--top``: default: unspecified.
* ``-o, --output``: default: unspecified.
* ``-s, --style``: default: unspecified; choices: gff, gtf.
* ``-v, --print``: default: False.

.. _cli-primer:

GenoKit primer
--------------

.. code-block:: text

   usage: GenoKit primer [-h] [-a MIN_GC] [-b MAX_GC] [-c MIN_TM] [-e MAX_TM]
                         -d DATABASE [-f {fasta,csv}] -g GENOME [-i GENE]
                         [-k KMER_BIN] [-l KMER_SIZE]
                         [--kmer-source {genome,transcriptome}] [-m MAX_LENGTH]
                         [-n MIN_LENGTH] [-o OUTPUT] [-s {gff,gtf}] [-x MIN_SIZE]
                         [-y MAX_SIZE] [-v] [--template-type {genomic,cdna}]
                         [--jellyfish JELLYFISH]
   
   options:
     -h, --help            show this help message and exit
     -a, --min_gc MIN_GC   min GC content, (default: 0.4)
     -b, --max_gc MAX_GC   max GC content, (default: 0.6)
     -c, --min_tm MIN_TM   min tm value, (default: 50)
     -e, --max_tm MAX_TM   max tm value, (default: 70)
     -d, --database DATABASE
                           SQLite (.sqlite) or pickle (.pkl) database generated by create
     -f, --output_format {fasta,csv}
                           output format (default: csv)
     -g, --genome GENOME   genome fasta file
     -i, --gene GENE       specific gene (optional); if not given,
                           return all genes in database
     -k, --kmer_bin KMER_BIN
                           GenoKit k-mer SQLite database used to calculate Kmer_freq
     -l, --kmer_size KMER_SIZE
                           the kmer length of kmer binary database 
     --kmer-source {genome,transcriptome}
                           k-mer source; defaults to genome for genomic templates or transcriptome for cdna; must match --template-type
     -m, --max_length MAX_LENGTH
                           primer length (bp), (default: 25)
     -n, --min_length MIN_LENGTH
                           primer length (bp), (default: 18)
     -o, --output OUTPUT   output file path
     -s, --style {gff,gtf}
                           gtf database or gff database
     -x, --min_size MIN_SIZE
                           min target region length (bp), (default: 100)
     -y, --max_size MAX_SIZE
                           max target region length (bp), (default: 1000)
     -v, --print           output to stdout. -v and -o option are mutually exclusive
     --template-type {genomic,cdna}
                           primer template: genomic gene DNA including introns, or mature spliced cdna (default: cdna)
     --jellyfish JELLYFISH
                           optional Jellyfish executable for .jf queries; specify if the saved path is invalid or Jellyfish is not on PATH

**Parser defaults and requirements**

* ``-a, --min_gc``: default: 0.4.
* ``-b, --max_gc``: default: 0.6.
* ``-c, --min_tm``: default: 50.
* ``-e, --max_tm``: default: 70.
* ``-d, --database``: required.
* ``-f, --output_format``: default: 'csv'; choices: fasta, csv.
* ``-g, --genome``: required.
* ``-i, --gene``: default: unspecified.
* ``-k, --kmer_bin``: default: unspecified.
* ``-l, --kmer_size``: default: unspecified.
* ``--kmer-source``: default: unspecified; choices: genome, transcriptome.
* ``-m, --max_length``: default: 25.
* ``-n, --min_length``: default: 18.
* ``-o, --output``: default: unspecified.
* ``-s, --style``: default: unspecified; choices: gff, gtf.
* ``-x, --min_size``: default: 100.
* ``-y, --max_size``: default: 1000.
* ``-v, --print``: default: False.
* ``--template-type``: default: 'cdna'; choices: genomic, cdna.
* ``--jellyfish``: default: unspecified.

.. _cli-motif:

GenoKit motif
-------------

.. code-block:: text

   usage: GenoKit motif [-h] [-b] [-c] [-d] [-e] [-f FILE] -i INPUT [-m MOTIF]
                        [-o OUTPUT] [-t {dna,rna}] [-x MISMATCHES]
   
   options:
     -h, --help            show this help message and exit
     -b, --both-strands    search on both chains
     -c, --case-sensitive  case sensitive
     -d, --degenerate      using IUPAC degenerate bases
     -e, --regex           using regular expressions
     -f, --file FILE       a file containing multiple motifs (one per line)
     -i, --input INPUT     input fasta file
     -m, --motif MOTIF     sequence pattern
     -o, --output OUTPUT   output file path
     -t, --type {dna,rna}  seq type: dna or rna
     -x, --mismatches MISMATCHES
                           Maximum number of mismatches allowed

**Parser defaults and requirements**

* ``-b, --both-strands``: default: False.
* ``-c, --case-sensitive``: default: False.
* ``-d, --degenerate``: default: False.
* ``-e, --regex``: default: False.
* ``-f, --file``: default: unspecified.
* ``-i, --input``: required.
* ``-m, --motif``: default: unspecified.
* ``-o, --output``: default: unspecified.
* ``-t, --type``: default: 'dna'; choices: dna, rna.
* ``-x, --mismatches``: default: 0.

   usage: GenoKit ppi [-h] -i INPUT [-s {tab,comma}] [-o OUTPUT_DIR]

.. _cli-view:

GenoKit view
------------

.. code-block:: text

   usage: GenoKit view [-h] -d DATABASE [-f {pdf,png,tiff}] -g GENOME [-i GENE]
                       [-l LENGTH] [--orf-label-limit ORF_LABEL_LIMIT]
                       [-o OUTPUT_DIR] [-s {gff,gtf}] [-v]
   
   options:
     -h, --help            show this help message and exit
     -d, --database DATABASE
                           SQLite (.sqlite) or pickle (.pkl) database generated by create
     -f, --output_format {pdf,png,tiff}
                           output format (default: pdf)
     -g, --genome GENOME   genome fasta file
     -i, --gene GENE       specific gene (optional); if not given, return all genes in database
     -l, --length LENGTH   minimum uORF/dORF length in nt; shorter ORFs are hidden (default: 6)
     --orf-label-limit ORF_LABEL_LIMIT
                           show individual ORF numbers only when a transcript has no more than this many ORFs; use 0 to hide all numbers (default: 20)
     -o, --output_dir OUTPUT_DIR
                           output directory path
     -s, --style {gff,gtf}
                           gtf database or gff database
     -v, --print           output to stdout. -v and -o option are mutually exclusive

**Parser defaults and requirements**

* ``-d, --database``: required.
* ``-f, --output_format``: default: 'pdf'; choices: pdf, png, tiff.
* ``-g, --genome``: required.
* ``-i, --gene``: default: unspecified.
* ``-l, --length``: default: 6.
* ``--orf-label-limit``: default: 20.
* ``-o, --output_dir``: default: unspecified.
* ``-s, --style``: default: unspecified; choices: gff, gtf.
* ``-v, --print``: default: False.

.. _cli-circos:

GenoKit circos
--------------

.. code-block:: text

   usage: GenoKit circos [-h] [-a CHROM] [-b BAR] [-c CYTOBAND]
                         [-f {pdf,png,tiff}] [-k LINK] [-l LINE] [-t TRACK]
                         [-m HEATMAP] [-w WINDOW] [-o OUTPUT_FILE] [-p POINT]
                         [-s {gff,gtf}] [-v]
   
   options:
     -h, --help            show this help message and exit
     -a, --chrom CHROM     chromosome length file (chr,start,end)
     -b, --bar BAR         barplot track file (chr,start,end,value)
     -c, --cytoband CYTOBAND
                           cytoBand track file (chr1,1,2300000,p36.33,gneg)
     -f, --output_format {pdf,png,tiff}
                           output format (default: pdf)
     -k, --link LINK       link track file (chr1,start1,end1,chr2,start2,end2)
     -l, --line LINE       line track file (chr,start,end,value)
     -t, --track TRACK     line or link track file (automatically detected from its header)
     -m, --heatmap HEATMAP
                           heatmap track file (chr,start,end,value)
     -w, --window WINDOW   window size, (default: 1000000)
     -o, --output_file OUTPUT_FILE
                           output file path
     -p, --point POINT     Point track file (chr,start,end,value)
     -s, --style {gff,gtf}
                           gtf database or gff database
     -v, --print           output to stdout. -v and -o option are mutually exclusive

**Parser defaults and requirements**

* ``-a, --chrom``: default: unspecified.
* ``-b, --bar``: default: unspecified.
* ``-c, --cytoband``: default: unspecified.
* ``-f, --output_format``: default: 'pdf'; choices: pdf, png, tiff.
* ``-k, --link``: default: unspecified.
* ``-l, --line``: default: unspecified.
* ``-t, --track``: default: unspecified.
* ``-m, --heatmap``: default: unspecified.
* ``-w, --window``: default: 1000000.
* ``-o, --output_file``: default: unspecified.
* ``-p, --point``: default: unspecified.
* ``-s, --style``: default: unspecified; choices: gff, gtf.
* ``-v, --print``: default: False.

.. _cli-terminator:

GenoKit terminator
------------------

.. code-block:: text

   usage: GenoKit terminator [-h] -d DATABASE [-f {csv,fasta,gff,gtf}] -g GENOME
                             [-i GENE] [-l TERMINATOR_LENGTH] [-o OUTPUT]
                             [-s {gff,gtf}] [-u UTR3_LOWER_LENGTH] [-v]
   
   options:
     -h, --help            show this help message and exit
     -d, --database DATABASE
                           SQLite (.sqlite) or pickle (.pkl) database generated by create
     -f, --output_format {csv,fasta,gff,gtf}
                           output format
     -g, --genome GENOME   genome fasta path
     -i, --gene GENE       specific gene (optional); if not given, return whole genes
     -l, --terminator_length TERMINATOR_LENGTH
                           terminator length (default: 100)
     -o, --output OUTPUT   output file path
     -s, --style {gff,gtf}
                           genome annotation file format
     -u, --utr3_lower_length UTR3_LOWER_LENGTH
                           3' length (default: 10)
     -v, --print           output to stdout

**Parser defaults and requirements**

* ``-d, --database``: required.
* ``-f, --output_format``: default: unspecified; choices: csv, fasta, gff, gtf.
* ``-g, --genome``: required.
* ``-i, --gene``: default: unspecified.
* ``-l, --terminator_length``: default: 100.
* ``-o, --output``: default: unspecified.
* ``-s, --style``: default: unspecified; choices: gff, gtf.
* ``-u, --utr3_lower_length``: default: 10.
* ``-v, --print``: default: False.

   usage: GenoKit uorf [-h] -d DATABASE [-f {csv,fasta,gff,gtf}] -g GENOME
                       [-i TRANSCRIPT] [-l LENGTH] [-m SCHEMATIC_WITHOUT_INTRON]
                       [-n SCHEMATIC_WITH_INTRON] [-o OUTPUT] [-s {gff,gtf}] [-v]
   
   options:
     -h, --help            show this help message and exit
     -d, --database DATABASE
                           SQLite (.sqlite) or pickle (.pkl) database generated by create
     -f, --output_format {csv,fasta,gff,gtf}
                           output format (default: csv)

                           specific transcript id (extract all if omitted)
     -l, --length LENGTH   uorf length threshold, (default: 6)
     -m, --schematic_without_intron SCHEMATIC_WITHOUT_INTRON
                           schematic figure file for uorf, cds
                           and transcript without intron
     -n, --schematic_with_intron SCHEMATIC_WITH_INTRON
                           schematic figure file for uorf, cds
                           and transcript with intron
     -o, --output OUTPUT   output file path
     -s, --style {gff,gtf}
                           gtf database or gff database
     -v, --print           output to stdout. -v and -o option are mutually exclusive

.. _cli-shrna:

GenoKit shrna
-------------

.. code-block:: text

   usage: GenoKit shrna [-h] -d DATABASE [-f {csv,fasta}] -g GENOME [-i GENE]
                        [-k KMER_BIN] [--jellyfish JELLYFISH] [-l {19,20,21}]
                        [-o OUTPUT] [-p LOOP] [-s {gff,gtf}]
                        [--region {cds,transcript}] [--target-mode {all,any}]
                        [-v]
   
   options:
     -h, --help            show this help message and exit
     -d, --database DATABASE
                           SQLite (.sqlite) or pickle (.pkl) database generated by create
     -f, --output_format {csv,fasta}
                           output format (default: csv)
     -g, --genome GENOME   genome fasta file
     -i, --gene GENE       specific gene id (extract all if omitted)
     -k, --kmer_bin KMER_BIN
                           transcriptome-source GenoKit k-mer SQLite database
     --jellyfish JELLYFISH
                           optional Jellyfish executable for .jf queries; specify if the saved path is invalid or Jellyfish is not on PATH
     -l, --length {19,20,21}
                           shRNA target length: 19, 20, or 21 nt (default: 21)
     -o, --output OUTPUT   output file path
     -p, --loop LOOP       loop: an ATCG sequence, or standard/miR30/simple (default: CTCGAG)
     -s, --style {gff,gtf}
                           gtf database or gff database
     --region {cds,transcript}
                           target region: CDS (default; exons if no CDS) or mature transcript
     --target-mode {all,any}
                           target all input transcripts of each gene (default) or at least one transcript
     -v, --print           output to stdout. -v and -o option are mutually exclusive

**Parser defaults and requirements**

* ``-d, --database``: required.
* ``-f, --output_format``: default: 'csv'; choices: csv, fasta.
* ``-g, --genome``: required.
* ``-i, --gene``: default: unspecified.
* ``-k, --kmer_bin``: default: unspecified.
* ``--jellyfish``: default: unspecified.
* ``-l, --length``: default: 21; choices: 19, 20, 21.
* ``-o, --output``: default: unspecified.
* ``-p, --loop``: default: 'CTCGAG'.
* ``-s, --style``: default: unspecified; choices: gff, gtf.
* ``--region``: default: 'cds'; choices: cds, transcript.
* ``--target-mode``: default: 'all'; choices: all, any.
* ``-v, --print``: default: False.

.. _cli-hgvs:

GenoKit hgvs
------------

.. code-block:: text

   usage: GenoKit hgvs [-h] [-i INPUT] [-s STRING]
                       [--variation {sub,del,ins,delins,dup,inv,rpt,alleles,ext,fs}]
                       [-o OUTPUT] [--genbank GENBANK] [--cache-dir CACHE_DIR]
                       [--context CONTEXT] [--dpi DPI] [--email EMAIL]
                       [--api-key API_KEY] [--allow-reference-mismatch]
                       [--skip-three-prime-check]
   
   Build a tool for visualizing HGVS nomenclature.
   A letter prefix indicates the type of reference sequence used.
   Accepted prefixes are;
       • c for a coding DNA reference sequence,
       • g for a linear genomic reference sequence,
       • m for a mitochondrial DNA reference sequence,
       • n for a non-coding DNA reference sequence,
       • o for a circular genomic reference sequence,
       • p for a protein reference sequence,
       • r for an RNA reference sequence (transcript).
   
   options:
     -h, --help            show this help message and exit
     -i, --input INPUT     text/CSV file containing one HGVS expression per line
     -s, --string STRING   DNA, RNA or protein HGVS expression (g./c./n./m./o., r. or p.)
     --variation {sub,del,ins,delins,dup,inv,rpt,alleles,ext,fs}
                           optional expected variation type used for validation
     -o, --output OUTPUT   output PNG/PDF/SVG path; for multiple inputs, output directory or prefix
     --genbank GENBANK     local GenBank/GenPept file instead of downloading from NCBI
     --cache-dir CACHE_DIR
                           NCBI GenBank cache directory (default: .genokit_cache/hgvs)
     --context CONTEXT     flanking bases/residues displayed in the detailed panel (default: 20)
     --dpi DPI             raster output resolution (default: 200)
     --email EMAIL         email sent to NCBI E-utilities (or set NCBI_EMAIL)
     --api-key API_KEY     NCBI API key (or set NCBI_API_KEY)
     --allow-reference-mismatch
                           draw an invalid reference allele as a warning instead of stopping
     --skip-three-prime-check
                           skip the local 3' check for simple del/dup/ins diagnostic input

**Parser defaults and requirements**

* ``-i, --input``: default: unspecified.
* ``-s, --string``: default: unspecified.
* ``--variation``: default: unspecified; choices: sub, del, ins, delins, dup, inv, rpt, alleles, ext, fs.
* ``-o, --output``: default: unspecified.
* ``--genbank``: default: unspecified.
* ``--cache-dir``: default: '.genokit_cache/hgvs'.
* ``--context``: default: 20.
* ``--dpi``: default: 200.
* ``--email``: default: unspecified.
* ``--api-key``: default: unspecified.
* ``--allow-reference-mismatch``: default: False.
* ``--skip-three-prime-check``: default: False.
